<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="3" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="oA7uD6s2pZaSCWQxgzEU"> <mxGraphModel dx="5563" dy="2533" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "
@startuml
title Fig. 3. Reference architecture of evolution-aware monitoring (L1-L6)

left to right direction
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam roundcorner 12
skinparam linetype ortho

skinparam rectangle {
 BackgroundColor #DCE9FA
 BorderColor #658ABE
 FontColor #172536
}

rectangle \"Observability and\nruntime sources\" as Sources #F1F1F1
rectangle \"Operational\nenvironment\" as Env #F1F1F1
rectangle \"Monitored IS /\ndynamic MAS\" as IS #F1F1F1
rectangle \"Runtime state\nstore\" as Store #D8E9D4

package \"Evolution-aware monitoring platform\" as EAM {

 rectangle \"L1 Evidence\nacquisition\" as L1
 rectangle \"L2 Normalization\nand correlation\" as L2
 rectangle \"L3 Runtime model\nreconstruction\" as L3
 rectangle \"L4 Drift vector\nand EDI\" as L4
 rectangle \"L5 Interpretation\nand assessment\" as L5
 rectangle \"L6 Response and\nre-check zone A(t)\" as L6

 L1 -down-> L2 : raw evidence
 L2 -right-> L3 : normalized evidence
 L3 -down-> L4
 L4 -down-> L5 : Δrun, Δrel
 L5 -down-> L6 : state, trend
}

rectangle \"Knowledge base\n(K, ΦD)\" as KB #D8E9D4
rectangle \"Operator /\ngovernance\" as Gov #FFF0CA

Sources --> L1
Env --> L1
IS --> L1

L2 --> Store : store evidence,\nmodels, drift, actions

KB --> L4 : reference model
KB --> L5 : rules, ontologies

L5 --> Gov : alerts
Gov --> KB : maintains
Gov --> L6 : reviews / approves

L6 --> IS : probe updates,\ncorrections, escalation

@enduml
",
 "config": null

 "data": "
@startuml
title Fig. 3. Reference architecture of evolution-aware monitoring (L1-L6)

left to right direction
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam roundcorner 12
skinparam linetype ortho

skinparam rectangle {

 BorderColor #658ABE
 FontColor #172536
}

rectangle \"Observability and\nruntime sources\" as Sources #F1F1F1
rectangle \"Operational\nenvironment\" as Env #F1F1F1
rectangle \"Monitored IS /\ndynamic MAS\" as IS #F1F1F1
rectangle \"Runtime state\nstore\" as Store #D8E9D4

package \"Evolution-aware monitoring platform\" as EAM {

 rectangle \"L1 Evidence\nacquisition\" as L1
 rectangle \"L2 Normalization\nand correlation\" as L2
 rectangle \"L3 Runtime model\nreconstruction\" as L3
 rectangle \"L4 Drift vector\nand EDI\" as L4
 rectangle \"L5 Interpretation\nand assessment\" as L5
 rectangle \"L6 Response and\nre-check zone A(t)\" as L6

 L1 -down-> L2 : raw evidence
 L2 -right-> L3 : normalized evidence
 L3 -down-> L4
 L4 -down-> L5 : Δrun, Δrel
 L5 -down-> L6 : state, trend
}

rectangle \"Knowledge base\n(K, ΦD)\" as KB #D8E9D4
rectangle \"Operator /\ngovernance\" as Gov #FFF0CA

Sources --> L1
Env --> L1
IS --> L1

L2 --> Store : store evidence,\nmodels, drift, actions

KB --> L4 : reference model
KB --> L5 : rules, ontologies

L5 --> Gov : alerts
Gov --> KB : maintains
Gov --> L6 : reviews / approves

L6 --> IS : probe updates,\ncorrections, escalation

@enduml
",
 "config": null
}"/>

left to right direction

  rectangle "L2 Normalization\nand correlation" as L2
  rectangle "L3 Runtime model\nreconstruction" as L3

  L1 -down-> L2 : raw evidence
  L2 -right-> L3 : normalized evidence
  L3 -down-> L4
  L4 -down-> L5 : Δrun, Δrel
  L5 -down-> L6 : state, trend
}

rectangle "Knowledge base\n(K, ΦD)" as KB #D8E9D4

Sources --> L1
